trigger.description: ee mesh sync ran with mesh enabled and at least one ACTIVE peer enrolled — an anti-entropy round was warranted — but no peer transport path exists to carry it (the real transport lands with team-confed T2.4), so no round ran. Reported at the anti-entropy level alongside the CLI-level mesh_sync_once_network_deferred so agents can distinguish 'nothing to sync' from 'peers are waiting and the transport is the gap'.
